outputs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original Peatflare Jarrier battle animation additions. Image 1 is the fixed character/costume/paint reference, not the pose layout. Paint THREE complete full-body poses in ONE horizontal row with broad empty gutters, identical body scale and elevated three-quarter view facing RIGHT. Same wiry adult woman, dark hair bun/loose forelock, olive scarf, worn brown leather crossed straps, ragged dark teal cape, charcoal trousers, wrapped brown boots, soot-dark ceramic ember jars on belt. LEFT pose: melee recovery immediately after a RIGHT-hand punch toward RIGHT, right elbow bends drawing the EMPTY right fist back across chest to ribs, left fist protects chin, jars all stowed at belt, knees slightly bent. MIDDLE: ready defensive stance with BOTH EMPTY fists raised near brow, torso partly crouched, jars stowed, same arm ownership. RIGHT: running passing phase with ONE straight support leg planted under hips and OTHER knee bent with boot lifted under the pelvis, not a long split stride; right hand retains one corked glowing jar snug by torso, left arm balances, cape trails behind. All bodies full, fingers and boots in frame. Preserve the reference small-head realistic anatomy, weathered cloth paint, subdued palette and gear, no new weapon. Background perfectly flat opaque pure magenta RGB255,0,255 with no reflected magenta/no shadow. No text, grid, border, particles, fire effects, extra objects or cropped extremities.
